prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: selectable PLAYER CITY miniature artwork for an existing WWII-inspired isometric mobile strategy game.
Primary request: One richly detailed, beautiful fortified living city, with a complete square perimeter of defensive walls, one large gate centered on EACH of the FOUR wall sides, and recognizable defensive artillery turrets on EVERY wall side. Outside the wall is ONE continuous ring of blue-green water moat. FOUR separate bridges cross the moat, exactly one aligned with each gate, with roads continuing through each gate into the city. All four gate-and-bridge pairs must exist and be legible, including the two far gates, with sightlines left open.
Inside the walls: an organized coherent street plan, residential neighborhoods with many individual buildings and roofs, tiny walking civilians, sidewalks and plazas, paved roads, small cars and military-era trucks, trees and planted yards, a visible radar installation. The largest and most important building is the CITY HALL located at the EXACT geometric center, surrounded by an open civic square. Directly beside the central city hall stands a recognizable tall communications / signal tower BUILDING with antenna mast and dishes. Other roofs remain lower to keep the central civic buildings readable. Show roads actually connecting gates, bridges, neighborhoods, and the center.
Style/medium: premium game-ready 3D architectural miniature, finely modeled stone, plaster, concrete, metal and roofs, appealing realistic material rendering with restrained stylization; detailed yet visually organized. No sci-fi, no futuristic neon, no fantasy castle.
Composition: single entire city centered in a square image, diamond-oriented square layout, orthographic isometric three-quarter overhead camera, around 40 degrees above horizon so roofs and front facades are visible. Fit the whole moat ring and all four bridge ends inside the image with 6 percent margin. Moderate-height walls so interior streets and far gate entrances are visible. Preserve a strong square/diamond silhouette for a 2x2-cell map city. Maintain convincing depth and three-dimensional buildings.
Ground treatment: city sits directly on a thin natural grass-and-soil surface, NO raised display plinth, NO thick block of cut earth, NO vertical soil slab, NO floating island, NO black outline. Natural soft uneven grass fringe beyond the moat transitions gently into a plain muted sage-olive background. Ground plane stays flat. Only buildings and defensive walls have height. Water is at ground level.
Lighting: clear soft daytime sunlight from upper left, delicate ambient occlusion, short gentle shadows, crisp readable details and warm/cool balance. Same camera and daytime lighting across variants for fair comparison.
Constraints: one image, one city, no collage, no inset views, no UI, no labels, no letters, no logos, no watermark. The four bridges and four gate openings must be distinct; do not fill or break the moat accidentally. People are tiny scale cues. The central city hall is a civic building, not a castle keep.

Architecture direction: elegant European neoclassical administrative city. Central symmetrical limestone city hall with broad stairs, colonnaded facade, green copper dome and clock; a neighboring narrow pale-stone signal tower building. Slate-blue roofs and warm cream residential blocks, gridded avenues, square corner bastions and stone curtain walls with steel artillery positions. Four stone arch bridges. Spacious orderly ceremonial main roads and a lived-in town atmosphere.
